parts.html: The K-21 kitchen model combines a timeless white palette with neoclassical styling and an efficient L-shaped layout. Its coordinated cabinet fronts create a calm, elegant furniture composition, while the corner configuration makes practical use of two adjoining walls.

The white finish provides a versatile foundation for a variety of residential interiors. It can be paired with natural wood, stone textures, light ceramic tile, and warm decorative accents. The neoclassical character of the kitchen offers a balance between traditional elegance and the clean appearance expected in contemporary homes.

K-21 has a total linear length of 4.7 meters. The L-shaped arrangement provides space for work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinet storage while preserving floor area for a dining zone and comfortable circulation. A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard model.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts have a foil-wrapped finish. Their consistent white color brings the kitchen together as one cohesive furniture composition. The cabinet structure is made from 18 mm laminated particleboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based.

The standard hardware configuration includes Muller hinges with soft-close, allowing hinged cabinet doors to close smoothly. Pull-out elements use Muller telescopic runners without soft-close. Cabinet handles are included; pull-out cargo storage and lift mechanisms are not part of the standard specification.

The K-21 model can also be customized beyond its standard materials and hardware. Upon request, the kitchen can be equipped with more advanced furniture fittings and additional functional storage systems. It can also be manufactured using alternative materials, ranging from more budget-friendly options to premium finishes. The final specification is selected according to the client’s preferences, functional requirements, and project budget.
Drawer runners: Muller telescopic runners without soft-close
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-21 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, plumbing and electrical connections, and built-in appliance requirements. Our team helps plan the cabinetry and select suitable fronts, countertops, hardware, and internal storage.
Our services include kitchen design, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Sinks, taps, extractor hoods, and appliances can also be selected according to the client’s requirements.
